_comment: --cms=none: the homepage becomes the static <HomeFallback>, with no CMS page fetch and no Prepr preview/tracking. A TEXT PATCH, not a full-file copy, deliberately: the copy this replaced was frozen at the June boilerplate and still carried the `NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_CATEGORY_ID || '17'` literal that was removed everywhere else, so the homepage grid asked for a category the shop may not have. If the boilerplate edits one of these snippets the scaffolder now fails loudly instead of shipping a stale homepage.
